reaction: Finish a storehouse before the storm: I understand why I am here. The title has its last letter on another line. I can read the instructions, but the recording strip covers the bottom of New game. New concepts, 12: shared workshop, Alder Quay, storehouse, storm deadline, eight residents, personal limits, prepared boards, ballast bags as weights, hand tools, trolleys carrying loads, residents choosing manageable work, menu pauses. Recording across games is familiar from my earlier visits.

I chose Nora because she is first. Nora designs repairs and makes things; boards sound suitable. I am not sure what People 8/10 means. New concepts, 14 on entering play: supply totals, people fraction, three speeds, select person then work, keeping supplies dry, running clock, 10:00 storm, 180-board and 120-bag cost, named resident selection, All and Clear, others covering usual work, rest and resume, eating and drinking, cabin preparation for 40 boards. New concepts, 5 after Nora: waiting status, no powered tools, no structural changes, Nora lives here and is 28, Nora designs and makes things. Move and Insist on work are two more new actions, bringing entering-play concepts to 16.

I am on my way. That is a reassuring answer. I thought Boards might mean making boards; now I see she collects them. New concepts, 2: travel before work, collecting prepared boards. The little workshop picture is hard for me to read, but the words tell me what Nora is doing.

I have got Nora working and the boards have risen to 84. I meant to look at Sam, but I have selected two people. Reread 1: “2 people are selected. Nora is working.” I needed to read that again because I expected Sam’s description, and Nora was still there. New concept, 1: selecting another person adds them to the selection. I am interested, but I need to be careful with these buttons.

Feedback has I’m confused. I chose it, and the game put I’m confused into the note box itself. I did not type or submit. New concepts, 2 in the menu: saving on this device and full screen. New concepts, 3 in Feedback: confusion and stopping choices, What is sent disclosure, choosing confusion fills the note. The other feedback controls are familiar from my earlier games.

Reread 2: “After a minute together, offer one person a break.” Together where? Nora and Sam are going to different work. I opened help because I wondered about People 8/10, and now I have instructions for a private conversation as well as building. That is my second reread. I want to stop here. I did learn that tapping Nora again leaves Sam selected, and I sent Sam for bags. New concepts, 4 from Sam: he is 18 and lives here, learning repairs, kitchen work, testing games. New concepts, 15 from help: soaked supplies if unfinished, cabin room for two, inviting a local helper at the hub, computer box selection, right-click orders, phone box selection, holding a destination, a minute together before a break, five-second wait, inviting conversation through About this resident, private sharing, optional collaboration, 35-second rest, meals used at the current place, pressure may be remembered. Selecting builders and placing the storehouse on open ground are 2 more, making 17 in help. The help picture starts halfway through a sentence at the top; I have the text reply, but I cannot see its heading in this picture.

I got two people started, which pleased me. But I came to build the storehouse and now I am trying to understand what a minute together means. I stop here after my second reread. I would close it, not leave it running. I would return if someone sat with me for the first few jobs; I would not choose another evening with it on my own.

After stopping I chose I’m stopping in Feedback. It became pressed and filled the note box with I’m stopping. I typed nothing and did not submit. The game is paused at 1:04. No new concept on these repeated screens. The browser is no longer needed.
